title: Holocaust Denial
summary: Holocaust denial falsely claims that the systematic genocide of approximately six million Jews by Nazi Germany never occurred or has been greatly exaggerated.
introduction: Holocaust denial is a form of antisemitism that attempts to negate the established facts of the Nazi genocide of European Jews. Deniers use various tactics including claiming that the number of victims has been exaggerated, that gas chambers never existed, that Nazi documentation is forged, and that survivor testimonies are unreliable. This denial contradicts overwhelming documentary, physical, and testimonial evidence from multiple sources including Nazi records, Allied documentation, survivor accounts, perpetrator confessions, and extensive archaeological and demographic research conducted by historians worldwide.
